items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: Jesse Sailis was the drummer, and I was the bassist.

ctx.x: I think it was William. William Woodman. I think. And Jesse Sailis was the drummer, and I was the bassist. And the three brothers, they doubled on instruments, like Brett played trombone and alto, and [Cony] played tenor and a trumpet. And then, William played piano. So it made it sound like a big band, you know. Had a little fun. And I left them, Joe
Comfort took my place with them.
